Test Case Title: View History Logs GRANT — history/audit logs shown app-wide
Preconditions: History/audit data exists (WO history, part sales history, parts order history).
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
1. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role > start from minimal/blank baseline. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Set exactly these toggles: View History Logs ON; WO View ON; Parts Department + children View ON. Click Save.
3. Go to Administration > Staff. Assign the custom role to the test user.
4. In a separate browser, log in as the test user.
5. Open a WO and locate the WO history/audit log; open part sales and parts order records and locate their history logs.
Expected Result: With View History Logs ON, history/audit logs are visible across the app.
Actual Result (Observed): viewHistoryLogs exists only as a cross-toggle and hydrates for Tech, but this build surfaces no general History/Audit-log page or API gated by it. No history-log surface to access.
Status Rationale: feature/permission not surfaced in this build (no history/audit-log page)

Test Case Title: Administrator: cannot be edited to lose Administration-pages access
Preconditions: Logged in as an Administrator. Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) is reachable. A test staff user exists with no custom role assigned.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
1. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Select the 'Administrator' system template.
3. Change: attempt to disable 'Access Administration pages' (Roles & Permissions / Staff / Settings).
4. Attempt to turn OFF the Administration-pages access toggle and Save.
Expected Result: The custom role cannot be saved with Admin-pages access removed; Administrator always retains admin access.
Actual Result (Observed): Administrator is a role TEMPLATE (slug=administrator, "Full system access") that fills the full permission set; there is no discrete "Administrator" permission/toggle in the catalog to disable. The premise (a lockable Administrator toggle) does not exist in this build.
Status Rationale: feature/permission not present in this build (Administrator is a template, not a discrete toggle)
